title: The Silent Thorn
premise: Wendell Oyelaran, the last apprentice of the Thornwright Guild, has survived a decade of hiding her small magics in the city of Vessengard, where magic is outlawed and guild members are hunted. When a dying courier presses a blood-marked map into her hands, she discovers it leads to the Emberhold, where the last dragon-fire burns beneath a king who was replaced years ago by a hollow thing wearing his crown. Hunted by the crown's inquisitors and joined by an exiled knight and a disgraced guild archivist who become the family she never had, Wendell must unbind the true king before the dragon-fire gutters out and magic dies with it. In the end she chooses love over duty—refusing to sacrifice her found family as the ritual demands—and instead binds herself to the fire, becoming the new living ember while freeing the king and kindling magic's return.
about_author: Hazel Okafor is a former archivist who grew up between Lagos and London, collecting folktales about fire-keepers and oath-breakers. The Silent Thorn is her debut novel, written in the margins of night shifts and fueled by strong tea.

chapters.title: Charms for a City That Forgot
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. She sells a luck-knot to a frightened child in Vessengard's night market, narrowly evading an inquisitor patrol, and returns to the crumbling guildhouse where only she remains. The beat establishes her loneliness, quiet defiance, and the daily cost of hiding what she is.

chapters.title: The Courier's Last Breath
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. A bleeding stranger collapses into her stall, pressing a blood-sealed map into her hands and whispering 'the king still breathes' before dying. Inquisitors arrive; Wendell flees with the map, which brands itself onto her palm. Beat: terror and irrevocable choice.

chapters.title: What the Map Wants
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV, shifting to Serah's. The map pulls Wendell toward the Emberhold; she seeks out Serah Vance, a disgraced guild archivist living in exile, who recognizes the seal as royal blood-magic. Beat: reluctant alliance, first hint that Wendell's guild lineage makes her the map's chosen bearer.

chapters.title: The Knight Without an Oath
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. On the road they are ambushed by crown hunters and saved by Dame Ilsa Reyne, a knight who abandoned her oath after discovering the king's secret. Ilsa joins them, revealing the thing on the throne is a Hollow—a creature that eats memory. Beat: found family begins to form.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Guild
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. The trio shelters in the ruined Thornwright chapterhouse, where Wendell confronts memories of her master's execution and learns from Serah that the guild once served the dragon-fire directly. Beat: grief transmuted into purpose; Wendell accepts her inheritance.

chapters.title: The Hollow Court
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. Disguised, they infiltrate the capital and witness the Hollow king at court—beautiful, wrong, feeding on courtiers' memories. Ilsa nearly breaks when the Hollow wears her dead commander's face. Beat: dread deepens; the enemy understands them intimately.

chapters.title: Inquisitor's Mercy
chapters.summary: Serah's POV. Captured by Inquisitor Dain Corvath, Serah bargains for their lives by revealing the map—then betrays him, discovering he secretly mourns the true king. A fragile, uneasy truce forms. Beat: moral complexity; even hunters are haunted, and trust becomes a weapon.

chapters.title: The Road Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Guided by the burning map, they descend into the Emberhold's tunnels as the dragon-fire visibly gutters, causing magic everywhere to fail. Corvath's men pursue; Ilsa holds a pass alone. Beat: rising desperation, sacrifice foreshadowed, bonds tested.

chapters.title: The Unbinding
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. At the ember's heart they find the true king, half-dissolved into the Hollow, and learn the unbinding demands a life freely given. Wendell prepares to die; Ilsa and Serah refuse to let her. Beat: climax—the collision of duty, love, and selfhood at its sharpest.

chapters.title: The New Ember
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Instead of dying, Wendell binds herself to the fire as its living keeper, burning away the Hollow and freeing the king. Magic returns gently to the world; her found family stays beside her. Beat: resolution—identity embraced, love chosen over duty, dawn over Vessengard.
